newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian average lending rate flat at 10.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian average lending rate flat at 10.4 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate was flat at 10.4 percent on Wednesday, amid growing supply and low demand for fresh kuna funds.
Total settlements reached a modest 36.5 million kuna, of which 29 million kuna were fresh borrrowings. The end of trading left a surplus of 43.5 million kuna on the supply side.
Lenders pushed down call money rate to eight percent from Tuesday's nine percent, while some long-term loans were made at the rate of 17 percent.
Overnight trade reached a high 367 million kuna, which one bank used to square its position.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrates for Thursday firmer at 5.3869 against the dollar and 3.5658 against the German mark. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
